Phase 2C (process-list/cleanup): forgeops process-list (read-only Windows-native process discovery/classification via PowerShell/CIM + netstat, no psutil) and forgeops cleanup (conservative, dry-run-by-default; only an exact PID+repository+start-time registry match is ever a termination candidate; graceful taskkill only, never force; stale-record removal) - forgeops/state/runtime_registry.py, forgeops/detectors/processes.py, forgeops/detectors/process_association.py new; re-validated in a follow-up recovery session (real disposable-process execute + PID-reuse simulation, both fail closed correctly) - committed 2955b25 on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Context-Efficiency Foundation: forgeops resume-context (read-only, bounded-size compact resume summary - forgeops/state/resume_context.py, forgeops/cli/resume_context.py, forgeops/core/governance.py), three project-local skills (.claude/skills/forgeops-resume, forgeops-validate, forgeops-completion-report), one read-only subagent restricted to Read/Grep/Glob (.claude/agents/forgeops-recovery-reviewer.md), two minimal deterministic hooks (.claude/hooks/pretooluse_safety.py on Bash|Edit|Write|NotebookEdit; .claude/hooks/sessionend_handoff.py on SessionEnd, invoking the existing forgeops handoff writer), and a read-only Superpowers compatibility record (docs/superpowers-compatibility.md, not installed/cloned/executed) - see docs/context-efficiency.md; committed 1ab5f88 on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Safe Project Initialization: forgeops init [PATH] (safe, deterministic bootstrap of the minimum ForgeOps governance structure - CLAUDE.md, .agent/CURRENT_STATE.json, .agent/PROJECT_FACTS.md, .agent/DECISIONS.md, .agent/HANDOFF.md) - forgeops/state/project_init.py (preflight plan builder, content renderers, rollback-on-failure writer), forgeops/cli/init.py; forgeops/core/paths.py gained READONLY_REFERENCE_REPO/is_protected_reference_path (a second, independent TrendForge-protection layer alongside the existing PreToolUse hook); ownership/conflict model (missing/compatible/conflict per managed path, an ownership marker for markdown files, reused schema-version compatibility for CURRENT_STATE.json but intentionally more conservative than forgeops checkpoint's leniency), atomic all-or-nothing writes with rollback on failure, dry-run returning the same exit code a real run would, non-Git support, no speculative .agent/runtime|checkpoints|logs directories pre-created - see docs/project-init.md; 579 passing tests (up from 528); real disposable-directory validation (dry-run, real init, idempotent second run, JSON dry-run, CLAUDE.md conflict) executed this session - committed 0062fce on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Safe Git Worktree Foundation: forgeops worktree list (read-only) and forgeops worktree create NAME (mutating, --dry-run supported) - forgeops/worktrees/naming.py (NAME allow-list validation, deterministic forgeops/<name> branch naming, <repo-parent>/.forgeops-worktrees/<repo-name>/<name> managed root), forgeops/worktrees/git_worktree.py (tolerant git worktree list --porcelain parsing, git worktree add plumbing, no shell interpolation), forgeops/state/worktree_registry.py (.agent/runtime/WORKTREE_REGISTRY.json, atomic, schema-versioned, any single unreadable record fails the whole document closed - a deliberate deviation from runtime_registry.py's skip-bad-record behavior), forgeops/state/worktree_create.py (read-only preflight-plan builder shared by --dry-run and a real run, plus the single mutating apply step with partial-failure detection and a manual recovery recommendation - never a force-remove/prune/branch -D), forgeops/cli/worktree.py; branch is always newly created (git worktree add -b), never reused/reset; base ref resolved to a fixed commit SHA during preflight, never a moving ref; see docs/worktrees.md, including a documented known limitation (a true bare repository has no discoverable .git entry anywhere, so the shared repo-root discovery every command reuses can never find one - worktree create still safely refuses via REPO_NOT_FOUND rather than a false SUCCESS); 710 passing tests (up from 579); real disposable-repository validation this session (dry-run, real creation, listing the result, registry contents, source-checkout tracked files verified unmodified, no remote configured, conflict/edge cases exercised); on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing, uncommitted pending review (per this checkpoint's explicit stop-boundary instruction not to commit this work)
